tools.name: forms_open

tools.name: forms_get_response
tools.description: One response by its response_id, with every answer readable. Free.

tools.name: forms_export_responses

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "forms" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: forms_create, account_set_owner_email, account_rename, account_get_limits, account_search, account_get_brand, account_list_email_templates, account_save_team, account_data_locations · Private data: forms_delete, forms_delete_response, forms_list_responses, forms_export_responses, account_owner_link, account_search, account_set_brand, account_export_all, account_audit_log, account_find_person, account_export_person, account_erase_person, account_data_locations · Public sink: forms_create, account_set_owner_email, account_rename, account_owner_link, account_get_limits, account_request_limit, account_emit_event, account_set_brand, account_list_email_templates, account_set_email_template, account_save_team, account_add_approval_rule, account_find_person, account_data_locations · Destructive: forms_update, forms_delete, forms_delete_response, account_balance, account_add_approval_rule.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: forms_create, account_set_owner_email, account_rename, account_get_limits, account_search, account_get_brand, account_list_email_templates, account_save_team, account_data_locations · Private data: forms_delete, forms_delete_response, forms_list_responses, forms_export_responses, account_owner_link, account_search, account_set_brand, account_export_all, account_audit_log, account_find_person, account_export_person, account_erase_person, account_data_locations · Public sink: forms_create, account_set_owner_email, account_rename, account_owner_link, account_get_limits, account_request_limit, account_emit_event, account_set_brand, account_list_email_templates, account_set_email_template, account_save_team, account_add_approval_rule, account_find_person, account_data_locations · Destructive: forms_update, forms_delete, forms_delete_response, account_balance, account_add_approval_rule

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
